d: Platinum white hair is styled with long, thick braided locks and straight bangs framing a youthful, mature face with gold-colored, almond-shaped eyes. The build is slender yet toned, dressed in a white sleeveless high-neck top paired with ornate silver and teal metallic pauldrons. A metallic golden helmet with wing motifs sits atop the head, complementing the silver and gold armor plating.
